newPlayerRaids.$comment: The first `count` bot raids a village ever faces (after the new-player shield) bring a smaller, less researched army, so a new village with its first Kunai Tower usually holds (sim/defense.ts attackerFor).

defenseWin.$comment: A bot raid held to no star pays the defender this share of its Keep's lowest generated raid loot, in Coins and Provisions (storage-capped). Defense audit 2026-11-16 (DEF-01): with perStar every star the village denies pays a third of it (a raid held to one star pays two thirds, a three-star raid nothing), and the share went from 0.05 to 0.12. 0.12, not more: a village with every defense at its cap, raided about twice a day, is then paid under a fifth of what a regular player loots in a day at Keeps 9 to 15 (18% at Keep 15; 0.15 gave 23%), so defending is never a farm. Simulated raids only: a real player's raid pays honor, never resources (two accounts could trade it).

$commentCarry: Defense audit 2026-11-16 (DEF-01): a simulated raider carries home this share of what it broke open, by the stars it won (0 to 3). It used to carry everything whatever the stars, so a village that held every raid lost as much from the buildings that fell as one that lost. Measured with stores 30% full (docs/audit/understand-2026-11-16/PROGRESS.md): a village with defenses at its Keep's cap ends a raid about even at Keeps 9 to 15 (it used to lose 440 thousand to 9.8 million a raid), one with defenses at level 1 loses exactly what it lost before.

rematch.$comment: Settle the score: once per bot raid, within `windowHours`, attack the raider's own generated base. No loot from buildings and no honor; a win (1+ stars) pays `shareOfRaidLoot` x stars/3 of the Keep's lowest raid loot.

exhaustion.$comment: Balance audit 2026-11-08 (exhausted stores): each raid the village lost (1+ star) in the last windowHours multiplies what the next raider can take by factor, offline and online.

diversity.$comment: Balance audit 2026-11-08 (diversity carries more): a won raid carries minShare + (1 - minShare) x min(1, D / fullAt) of its loot, D = 1 - sum of squared housing shares by role of the warriors that fought (the hero not counted).

stakes.$comment: Balance audit 2026-11-08 (declared stakes, opt-in): before a raid the attacker may declare 2 or 3 stars; reaching it carries the loot x byStars[stake], missing it carries nothing and a real defender keeps it. Without a declaration a raid carries its loot as before.

$commentResume: Exploit audit 2026-11-16 (XPL-02): an interrupted Bounty Hunt attack or rematch still counts as begun when its record says for battleResumeHours after it would have ended; an older record is refused (the record's time is the game's to send).
